label: GO after an unrewarded trial (esp. unrewarded S2), first ~60 trials of the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (never D1/D2), and almost only when the previous trial was unrewarded (93% of mass has prev_reward==0; zero activity when the reward input is 1 at D1, it is silent at GO steps following rewarded trials except ~7% mass). Strongly tied to episode time: rate ~11% in trials 0-9, decaying to zero after trial ~65 (nothing in trials 70-99), i.e. it fires while the agent is early in the episode / value moderate (7.5-8.1). Biased toward the a2/S2 side: 77% of mass has prev_action a2, 81% has the agent choosing a2, and restricting to prev_state==S2 gives the best simple predicate (dev P 0.57 R 0.62 F1 0.60, mass recall 0.75). Broader GO & prev unrewarded & ep_trial<60 has recall 0.83/mass 0.92 but precision 0.33. Top activations are runs of unrewarded a2->S2 trials early in the episode. Missed activations are mostly weak ones (GO after rewarded trials, or after unrewarded S1 visits very early in the episode). All variables observed.
